entries.title: Psalms 89:1
segments: A Poem of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the mercies of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will make known Your faithfulness to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 89:2
segments: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up forever; You shall establish Your faithfulness in the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 89:3
segments: I have cut a covenant with My chosen; I have sworn to David My servant,

entries.title: Psalms 89:4
segments: Your seed will I establish forever, and build up your throne to all generations. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:5
segments: And the heavens shall praise Your wonders, O LORD, Your faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

entries.title: Psalms 89:6
segments: For who in the sky [or] can be ranked [with] the LORD? Who among the mighty is like the LORD?

entries.title: Psalms 89:7
segments: God is greatly to be feared in the congregation of the saints, and to be adored by all around Him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:8
segments: O LORD God of hosts, who [is] a strong LORD like You? And Your faithfulness is round about You?

entries.title: Psalms 89:9
segments: You rule the raging of the sea; when its waves arise, You still them.

entries.title: Psalms 89:10
segments: You have broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; You have scattered Your enemies with Your strong arm.

entries.title: Psalms 89:11
segments: The heavens [are] Yours, the earth also [is] Yours; You have founded the world and its fullness.

entries.title: Psalms 89:12
segments: The north and the south, You have created them; Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 89:13
segments: You have a mighty arm; Your hand is strong, [and] Your right hand is high.

entries.title: Psalms 89:14
segments: Justice and judgment [are] the foundation of Your throne; mercy and truth shall go before Your face.

entries.title: Psalms 89:15
segments: Blessed [is] the people that knows the joyful sound; they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of Your face.

entries.title: Psalms 89:16
segments: In Your name they shall rejoice all the day; and in Your righteousness they shall be lifted up.

entries.title: Psalms 89:17
segments: For You [are] the glory of their strength; and in Your favor our horn shall be lifted up.

entries.title: Psalms 89:18
segments: For the LORD [is] our shield; yea, our king [is] the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 89:19
segments: Then You spoke in a vision to Your holy one, and You said, I have laid help on a mighty one; I have lifted up a chosen one out of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 89:20
segments: I have found David, My servant; with My holy oil I have anointed him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:21
segments: My hand shall be always with him; My arm also shall make him strong.

entries.title: Psalms 89:22
segments: The enemy shall not use force on him, nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:23
segments: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague those who hate him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:24
segments: But My faithfulness and My mercy [shall be] with him; and in My name his horn [shall be] lifted up.

entries.title: Psalms 89:25
segments: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 89:26
segments: He shall cry to Me, My Father, You [are] my God, and the rock of my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 89:27
segments: And I will make him [My] first-born, higher than the kings of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 89:28
segments: I will keep My mercy for him forever, and My covenant shall stand fast with him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:29
segments: Also I have set his seed forever, and his throne as the days of the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 89:30
segments: If his children forsake My law, and do not walk in My judgments;

entries.title: Psalms 89:31
segments: if they profane My statutes, and do not keep My commandments;

entries.title: Psalms 89:32
segments: then I will visit their wickedness with the rod, and their sin with stripes.

entries.title: Psalms 89:33
segments: But I will not completely take My loving-kindness from him, and I will not be false in My faithfulness.

entries.title: Psalms 89:34
segments: I will not break My covenant, nor change the thing that has gone out of My lips.

entries.title: Psalms 89:35
segments: Once I have sworn by My holiness that I will not lie to David.

entries.title: Psalms 89:36
segments: His seed shall endure forever, and his throne as the sun before Me.

entries.title: Psalms 89:37
segments: It shall be established forever like the moon, and [like] a faithful witness in the heavens. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:38
segments: But You have cast off and rejected [us]; You have been angry with Your anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:39
segments: You have turned away from the covenant of Your servant; You have defiled his crown to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 89:40
segments: You have broken down all his hedges; You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

entries.title: Psalms 89:41
segments: All who pass by the way plunder him; he is a curse to his neighbors.

entries.title: Psalms 89:42
segments: You have set up the right hand of his enemies; You have made all [his] enemies rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 89:43
segments: You also have turned back the edge of his sword and have not made him stand in the battle.

entries.title: Psalms 89:44
segments: You have made his glory to cease, and have thrown his throne down to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 89:45
segments: The days of his youth You have shortened; You have covered him [with] shame. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:46
segments: How long, LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Shall Your wrath burn like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 89:47
segments: Remember, I pray, how short my time is; why have You made all men in vain?

entries.title: Psalms 89:48
segments: What man lives and never sees death? Shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:49
segments: O Lord, where [are] Your former loving-kindnesses [which] You swore to David in Your truth?

entries.title: Psalms 89:50
segments: Remember, Lord, the scorn of Your servants; [how] I bear in my bosom the insult of all the mighty people,

entries.title: Psalms 89:51
segments: [with] which Your enemies have cursed, O LORD; [with] which they have cursed the footsteps of Your anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:52
segments: Blessed [is] the LORD forevermore. Amen and Amen.
